Risk severity is high for public launch and medium for bounded changes that add no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Exact decision: retain private launch gates and authorize only bounded read-only security evidence work; ordinary reversible growth may continue within existing consent, disclosure, data-handling, claims, and platform-policy boundaries.
